subject: Banking
title: The Roadshow Spectacle
description: A quick, practical guide to The Roadshow Spectacle.

hook.text: Before an IPO, executives travel to 20+ cities in two weeks pitching their company to investors. This is the roadshow.

buildup.text: Roadshows include breakfast meetings in London, lunch in Frankfurt, dinner in New York. Every meal is a sales pitch.

discovery.text: Institutional investors use roadshows to decide how many shares to request. Their demand determines the final IPO price.

twist.text: Virtual roadshows emerged during COVID. Some companies now skip physical tours entirely.

climax.text: Roadshows are theater. The goal is creating FOMO among investors so demand exceeds supply and the price rises.

punchline.text: 20 cities in two weeks. The IPO roadshow is a sales marathon.

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of an IPO roadshow?
options: Generate investor demand and determine final share pricing
